defs.def: to tell the public about a product or a service in order to encourage people to buy or to use it 做广告；登广告

ex.s: These advertise the presence of chicks to adults; they might also encourage our chick to start calling as well.
ex.t: 这些（叫声）向成鸟宣告雏鸟的存在；它们也可能促使我们的雏鸟也开始鸣叫。

ex.s: Google initially used the data collected from users to target advertising better.
ex.t: 谷歌最初利用从用户处收集的数据来更好地定向投放广告。

ex.s: Customer: it is better to advertise when there are lots of viewers?
ex.t: 顾客：观众众多的时候做广告比较好？

defs.def: to let people know that sth is going to happen, or that a job is available by giving details about it in a newspaper, on a notice in a public place, on the Internet, etc. （在报纸、公共场所公告牌、互联网等上）公布，征聘

ex.s: City tours Agency Contact: JaneSmith@HRCITYTOURS.com Dear Ms Smith, I wish to apply for the position of a local tour guide as advertised in the Daily News on 30 June.
ex.t: City tours代理联系方式： JaneSmith@HRCITYTOURS.com尊敬的Smith女士，我想申请《每日新闻》6月30日刊登的当地导游职位。

defs.def: to show or tell sth about yourself to other people 展现，宣传（自己的事）

ex.s: It’s thanks to these TV chefs rather than any advertising campaign that Britons are turning away from meat-and-two-veg and ready-made meals and becoming more adventurous in their cooking habits.
ex.t: 多亏了这些电视厨师而不是任何广告宣传活动，英国人正在远离“一肉两菜”和即食餐，在烹饪习惯上变得更具冒险精神。

ex.s: Similarly, shop owners are more likely to stock well- advertised products because they know customers are more likely to buy them.
ex.t: 同样，店主更有可能存放广告宣传良好的产品，因为他们知道顾客更有可能购买这些产品。

ex.s: Ben later joked that the job should have been advertised not as the “best”，but the “busiest job in the world”!
ex.t: Ben后来开玩笑说，这份工作不应该被宣传为“最好的” ，而是“世界上最忙的工作” ！

ex.s: The young people who run the shelter work hard to keep the place clean, take care of the animals, and advertise the animals so that they can be adopted.
ex.t: 经营庇护所的年轻人努力保持地方干净，照顾动物，宣传动物，以便他们可以被收养。
